title: Closure under negating input variables
statement: For every natural number $k$, the class of Boolean functions admitting a polynomial threshold representation of Fourier degree at most $k$ is closed under negating input variables: for any number of input coordinates, any assignment of signs to those coordinates, and any function in the class, the function obtained by multiplying each input coordinate by its assigned sign belongs to the same class.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number n of input coordinates
A sign assignment on the n coordinates
A Boolean function in the polynomial threshold class on n coordinates
